notes.title: Game update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, the new game version has updated the following content

1. Newly added self-activity function, when the girlfriend is idle, she will carry out activities on her own
2. Newly added some self-activity actions
3. Newly added some game tips, in the chat interface
4. Reduce the consumption of girlfriend's satiety
5. Optimized some game content

notes.title: English version update
notes.notes: Hello everyone, Now the game adds support for English, Can be selected in the first launch of the game, I wish you a happy game !

notes.title: Optimization update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this update has optimized Chinese Chess

1. Fixed a few cases where it may not be clickable
2. Newly added Chinese chess difficulty mode, which can be selected in the setting interface

I wish you a happy game !

notes.title: Game update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, the following content has been added in the new version

1.Added more game sound effects
2.Time pause function, time will not automatically increase after opening
3.Weather effect can be set to display
4.The position and rotation function of the character can be restored

I wish you a happy game !
